subject: angol
title: Too stressed to sleep
situation: You have received this e-mail from your English friend, Emma. She is studying for her exams and feels very stressed. Write a reply to her.
situationHu: Angol barátnőd, Emma, a vizsgák miatti stresszről panaszkodik; válaszolj neki, és adj tanácsokat.
stimulus:
Hi,
Sorry I haven't written for ages. I've got so many exams at the moment and I'm really stressed. I can't sleep well, I'm always tired and I never have time to see my friends. How do you deal with stress before exams? Have you got any tips?
Love,
Emma

points.text: say how you feel about Emma's problem and whether you have had similar experiences
describe what you do to relax before exams
give her two pieces of advice about sleep and free time
suggest something you could do together after her exams

usefulPhrases.en: I'm sorry to hear that you're so stressed.
I know exactly how you feel.
to go for a run / to listen to music
You should try to … / Why don't you …?
to take a short break every hour

checklistExtra: Tanácsadásnál változatos szerkezeteket használtam (should, why don't you, it's a good idea to)?

modelAnswer.text:
Hi Emma,

Thanks for your e-mail. I'm sorry to hear that you're so stressed, but I know exactly how you feel. Last spring I had lots of tests too, and I couldn't sleep properly for weeks.

When I'm stressed, I usually go for a run or listen to music. It really helps me to switch off.

First, you should try to put your phone away an hour before you go to bed. Second, why don't you meet your friends at the weekend, even just for a short walk?

When your exams are over, how about coming to stay with me in Pécs? We could go hiking together.

Good luck!
Lots of love,
Nóra

pointsCovered.quote: I'm sorry to hear that you're so stressed, but I know exactly how you feel. Last spring I had lots of tests too, and I couldn't sleep properly for weeks.
When I'm stressed, I usually go for a run or listen to music.
First, you should try to put your phone away an hour before you go to bed. Second, why don't you meet your friends at the weekend, even just for a short walk?
When your exams are over, how about coming to stay with me in Pécs?

notes: Feladat teljesítése: együttérzés és saját hasonló élmény, a saját pihenési módszer, pontosan két tanács (alvás és szabadidő), végül közös program – mind a négy szempont kidolgozott.
Hangnem: baráti válaszlevél – reagál Emma levelére („Thanks for your e-mail”), együttérző, és a „Lots of love” elköszönés illik a barátnők közötti viszonyhoz.
Szövegalkotás: a tanácsokat a „First, … Second, …” tagolja, a bekezdések a szempontok sorrendjét követik.
Nyelvhelyesség: változatos tanácsadó szerkezetek (you should try to, why don't you, how about + -ing) – pont ezt kéri a feladat ellenőrzőlistája is.
Érdemes megtanulni: „I know exactly how you feel”, „It really helps me to switch off”, „When your exams are over, how about …?”.
